related_gaps.rationale: Removing the template's own task history does not establish acceptance for an adopted product.
The closed gap's evidence cited a page this task archives; the evidence now names the archive commit. Its state, resolution and requirements are unchanged.

gap_review: Read the three open gaps (product-acceptance, platform-qualification, hosting-enforcement); none is changed. The closed gap artifact-gate-holes cited an archived page as evidence, so its evidence text is re-pointed.

discoveries.summary: Checking the archive commit on every coordination run would fail for an adopter who unpacks the template without history; the commit is read only when a deletion relies on it.
The stop hook judged every completed record of a stack kept on local branches against origin/main, because it looked for other branches only among remotes; it now counts local branches too.

.github/workflows/ci.yml keeps its mkdir and redirect, which work there; the runner now writes the same bytes to the same path. A failed check's tail is 30 lines in one field, not the brief's 20 per stream.

Two experiment runs found that coordination, and so check ci, fails for a record marked complete before its report page exists; the working order is report, then CI, then status complete. Not changed here.

discovery_review: Four discoveries: one changed the archive design before code, one is a stop-hook fix added beyond the ticket, one records two small deviations, and one is an ordering trap left as documented behaviour.

documentation.rationale: docs/COMPLETION.md documents the archive manifest, the optional remaining field and local stacks; docs/ARTIFACTS.md the 20 KB limit, hand corrections and the --head hint; docs/EVALUATION.md points the reviewer calibration at the archive commit; docs/ADOPTING.md says where the history is; docs/HARNESS.md, docs/READINESS.md, README.md and AGENTS.md describe the report path and output_tail.

prompt.area: xtask's handoff and transition gates (xtask/src/completion.rs, transitions.rs, history.rs), the check runner (runner.rs), the task record and the page router

summary: Add an archive manifest so merged task history can leave the tree, remove the template's own, and fix six points of friction from the first runs under the new tiers.

review.acceptance: All six named tests exist in xtask/tests/shipping.rs and pass: archived_history_may_be_deleted_and_nothing_else, a_profile_run_writes_its_report_where_the_docs_say, a_failed_check_shows_the_end_of_its_output, a_complete_record_needs_no_remaining_field, next_reports_a_standard_page_over_its_size_limit and a_late_brief_on_a_merge_commit_points_at_head. The eleven merged tasks' records, pages and receipts, the calibration drafts and their tickets are out of the tree (108 files); git ls-tree showcase/template-history lists the eleven records. Beyond the ticket: the archive commit must hold the same blob, and the stop hook handles local stacks (stop_judges_only_this_branchs_records_when_stacked).
review.verification: cargo xtask check ci passed 9 of 9 (target/verification/ci.json); cargo xtask handoff --base product/board-stats --report target/verification/ci.json accepts the deletions with harness/transitions/ship-clean.json. An export of this branch with no history (git archive, then git init) also passed check ci. Pages: brief.html pass in round 1 (0 findings); report.html pass in round 1 (0 findings); both reviewers left one non-blocking wording note each in reviews.json. GitHub Actions has not run: nothing is pushed, and showcase/template-history exists only locally until it is.
review.assumptions: The archive commit 0913680 is the current origin/main, so its objects travel with any clone that has the default branch; a shallow clone that lacks it could not verify a later deletion of archived paths. That other local branches mark stack boundaries assumes a local backup copy of the current branch is rare; such a copy hides this branch's records from the stop hook, as a pushed copy under another name already did, and PR CI still judges them.
review.coverage: No test runs the archive check against a shallow clone. The 20 KB limit is advice from next and a reviewer check, not a gate. The stop-hook change is tested with one local lower branch, not with several or with a local copy of the same branch. Codex hooks were not run.
